scope: Whole-request validator improvement, unchanged selected Qwen3.5-0.8B Q4_0 and original prompt/native. Optional pure focus summary integration separately tested; no task execution in confirmation.
development: All previously exposed balanced/train/dev/confirmation and existing app fixtures are development only; no new model checkpoint or adapter promoted.

fresh_cohort.counterparts: One supported request and one manually labelled unsupported near-neighbor, reciprocal IDs
fresh_cohort.author: Informed synthetic author; cannot read new candidate grammar or candidate tests; no model/gate/oracle filtering
fresh_cohort.novelty: Reject exact/normalized overlap with all available old author attempts/datasets/test requests plus candidate development fixtures; reject prior family/template IDs
fresh_cohort.manual_review: Before model or gate outputs; preserve old authored attempt on any repair; no post-output row/gold changes

capture.arms: One original-model native capture100, reused raw predictions for old and new gate; no model comparison or timing speedup claim
capture.runtime: existing pinned standalone C++/Homebrew CPU shared libs
capture.memory: Fresh newly allocated context per request; weights shared
capture.sampling: GBNF then greedy; actual canonical JSON+EOG required

qualification.promotion: Only after all criteria and exact candidate source integration/JVM/package checks. Real phone fixtures, foreground UI/voice and permission/lifecycle remain separate proof.

bindings: Append immutable source/runtime and actual fresh corpus/gold hashes before inference; do not edit this locked design.

storage.raw_data_and_captures: Ignored build/ only; no private data

limitations: Correlated informed synthetic pairs, no blind/population/ASR generalization
Strict unknown refusal does not prove strong raw model abstention
Constrained EOS does not establish unconstrained format reliability
Host fresh-context C API differs from production JNI and phone
Full proposal correctness does not prove Android execution or EXPLAIN task fulfillment
No NPU, Office Kit, training or causal interpretation result from this study
Pre-event research code is not eligible event-written competition code
